intro: Small shop. Real impact where we can measure it.

points.title: Cup deposit
points.body: Bring a mug, get 25¢ off. We wash loaners if you forget — no shame.

points.title: Spent grounds
points.body: Free for gardens. Bucket by the back door. First come, first served.

points.title: Local hiring
points.body: We post jobs on the bulletin board before anywhere else. Neighbors first.

points.title: Energy
points.body: Roaster runs on off-peak hours. Lights dim after the lunch rush. Not perfect — honest.
